signals.evidence: Air raid sirens activated in Upper Galilee border towns near Lebanon with immediate shelter-in-place directives issued in preparation for potential rocket attack
Firefighters handled suspicious package at airport with precautionary evacuation; military intercepted rocket launched from Iran toward northern territory
Iranian Revolutionary Guards confirmed five casualties from Israeli-American strike on Ardabil province

Senior Sergeant Gai Ludari died as a result of an operational error, becoming a victim of friendly fire during detention operation attempting to detain a Hezbollah terrorist in the village of Shiba in Lebanon

Police clashes with anti-war demonstrators at Tel Aviv protest near Habima Theatre, resulting in at least 17 arrests when air raid siren forced evacuation; one demonstrator injured and lost consciousness
Israeli Supreme Court ruled to expand permitted demonstration participation from 150 to 600 people near Habima Theatre, overriding military command restrictions
Schools preparing gradual return after Passover with teaching expected to resume April 12 in reduced format; Ben-Gurion Airport flight restrictions being eased beginning that day

Home Front Command Colonel confirms Passover camps approved by command are operating and special education services for children with special needs are permitted to continue, with all activities maintaining proximity to bomb shelters and compliance with one-minute shelter entry requirement

Home Front Command Colonel notes some municipalities have rejected shelter proximity requirements for special needs school activities while others comply, creating inconsistent implementation across regions
Home Front Command official reports 80% of injuries during this war occurred at home as a result of careless actions heading to shelters, indicating unsafe evacuation behavior

Home Front Command Colonel states: 'We all bow to court decisions even if we don't like them' and 'Home Front Command tries to allow routine life to continue on one hand while preserving life on the other'

Northern Israel education director states: 'Much less damage in the north today' and 'The citizens are standing at the front, they are the spearhead, they mark the way for us, and we must appreciate the people of the north very much'

Northern education official notes civilians have adapted to brief 15-second warning periods despite continued hardship, with much incoming fire directed at Israeli military forces within Lebanon rather than civilian targets

Official addresses immigrant population: 'Every one of us is doing something for the success of the war' and urges parents to engage children through structured activities, framing childcare as direct contribution to war effort

Supreme Court Chief Justice Yitzhak Amit stated: 'if we prohibit demonstrations, then this will no longer be a democratic state', asserting that maintaining democratic governance requires permitting protest during wartime
Senior sergeant killed in friendly fire during counter-terrorism operation in southern Lebanon; Iran launched missile attacks on Israel and Kuwait with air defenses intercepting weapons
Schools preparing for partial return to school right after Passover holiday with learning expected to gradually resume April 12 in shortened format pending security clearance
Education correspondent states: 'Some cities have no shelter at all, some authorities have nowhere even to hold studies' and 'Everything is very differential; some cities have no shelter at all'

Education correspondent reports: 'Some cities have no shelter at all, so we have no classes because we have no protected space' and 'For younger age groups this will be somewhat more complicated because most facilities are less protected or lack shelter entirely'

Education official states: 'Many educational institutions are still serving as shelters. Not every neighborhood has a shelter—some have none at all' and 'There are no clear answers. We don't know what happens with transportation'

Education correspondent confirms: 'We still continue the traffic light system; there are red, orange, yellow—it's constantly changing' with different municipalities maintaining different preparedness levels and shelter infrastructure

Education official states: 'No one clearly understands who will take responsibility. There's no way to safely operate the shuttles' and 'The situation where children must shelter during an alert while on a shuttle—that's also very complicated'

Education official notes: 'Schools are being used as shelters, many neighborhoods lack adequate shelter capacity, student transportation poses security risks, and there is no unified plan across municipalities'
Ben-Gurion Airport: passenger load raised from 50 to 80 persons per outbound flight; only one outbound and one inbound flight per hour permitted
During Passover week, normally 1.5 million Israelis travel; current operations at very low, very limited numbers
Of 80 available seats: 20 designated for humanitarian cases via Transport Ministry urgent committee; 60 allocated by ticket purchase date
Israeli airlines operating at drastically reduced capacity with near-empty flights generating minimal revenue; foreign airlines barred from operating to Israel
Technology expert recommends listeners verify phones support 4G networks and warns of scammers impersonating national insurance agency
Host: 'Computers and mobile phones are also our weapons...we have a wonderful opportunity today for Iosif Dolgoy to give you many useful recommendations. Please call us at 072-280-103'
Elderly caller Musy: new phone does not display caller ID numbers; expresses concern about unknown callers and fraud vulnerability
Caller asks: 'What accessibility options are available for polyphones for people like me?' seeking accessible technology solutions for vision-impaired users
Caller reports receiving persistent unwanted calls from unknown numbers that have her name and contact information; believes provider is selling her information
Expert: 'Time from time someone bad leaks data from phone companies...many people have access to this information and among them could be someone bad'
Expert announces air raid alarm on northern front: 'Please enter isolated rooms or shelters where you should remain at least 10 minutes after all-clear'
Caller reports Telegram account compromised after replying to message on April 1st; fraudulent messages sent to contacts asking for money
Expert: 'This is a fairly common problem and there is currently no solution for it' regarding Telegram account compromise
Second caller reports similar Telegram compromise affecting alternate account; fraudulent messages sent from alternate access point as well
Host advises: Israeli phone numbers with prefixes 052, 054, 077 are safe to answer; international numbers warrant caution; recommend hanging up and calling back official numbers directly
Caller warns: 'If you talk even for a minute, artificial intelligence records your voice and then your voice will be everywhere, they will use your voice to call everywhere'
Caller reports suspicious call impersonating radio station OREC asking about Russian-language speakers at bank: 'I was scared because of this'
Caller warns: 'Do not talk to suspicious numbers at all, preferably...artificial intelligence records your voice and then your voice will be everywhere'
Senior Sergeant Gai Ludar, 21 years old, killed in South Lebanon during counterterrorism operation; died from friendly fire due to identification error
